description: For over 25 years, 2Simple has been creating innovative educational technology that supports teaching and learning. Best known for Purple Mash, our award-winning platform for primary schools, we help educators engage learners, develop essential skills and make a positive impact every day. Trusted by schools worldwide, our solutions are designed by education experts and shaped by the needs of teachers and students.

ABE Global is an internationally recognised, not-for-profit awarding organisation that has been developing business education since 1973. Regulated in the UK by Ofqual, ABE provides qualifications and services for schools, further and higher education, and training providers, including affordable pathways to UK degrees. Our portfolio includes internationally recognised qualifications in business, leadership and entrepreneurship; ABE Business Builder , our practical entrepreneurship programme; Future Workskills , focused on immediately applicable workplace skills; and ABE Endorsed , which independently quality assures programmes and provides successful learners with ABE-branded certification. In Malaysia, ABE qualifications benefit from established funding routes, including eligibility for EPF (KWSP) Education Withdrawal , alongside HRD Corp funding opportunities where applicable . ABE’s mission is to empower people to transform their lives and communities through high-quality education and skills development. ABE is an independent subsidiary of The Institute of Leadership (IoL) .

Acer for Education delivers innovative, reliable hardware, software, and services specifically designed to break barriers between people and technology in the learning environment. This specialized division is backed by Acer’s legacy as one of the world’s top ICT companies. Founded in 1976, Acer now operates in over 160 countries with a global workforce of more than 7,000 employees dedicated to the research, design, marketing, and support of forward-thinking solutions. As the company looks into the future, it is focused on seamlessly fusing hardware, software, and services to open up new possibilities across service-oriented technologies, the Internet of Things (IoT) and gaming. In the local market, Acer Malaysia anchors this global vision with award-winning excellence, having been recognized with the BrandLaureate Fast Moving, Growing, Sustainable Business & Brands Award 2024 – Brands of the Year. This accolade underscores its strong brand presence, rapid growth, and deep commitment to sustainability in Malaysia. To support schools, universities, and commercial enterprises alike, Acer Malaysia distributes a comprehensive portfolio of technology and lifestyle brands, including Acerpure, Altos, AOpen, Aspire, Nitro, Swift, TravelMate, Veriton, and Predator. This extensive ecosystem encompasses laptops, desktops, monitors, projectors, servers, peripherals, and air purifiers tailored to create modern, healthy, and highly connected educational spaces. For more information, visit www.acer.com.

ActiveFloor is an innovative interactive learning solution that transforms any floor into an engaging digital learning and activity space. Using a projector and motion-tracking technology, users interact with educational games and activities through physical movement. Designed for schools, special education centres, senior care facilities and rehabilitation environments, ActiveFloor combines learning with movement to make activities more engaging and inclusive. It supports education, cognitive development, coordination, social interaction and physical activity, creating meaningful learning experiences for users of different ages and abilities.

Aktin Next is an education technology company dedicated to bringing innovative learning solutions to schools and educational institutions. With a focus on preparing students for the future, Aktin Next provides cutting-edge educational tools that make learning more interactive, engaging, and relevant to the skills of tomorrow. By combining technology, educational resources, and practical classroom applications, Aktin Next helps schools stay ahead in an evolving education landscape. Aktin Next offers a diverse portfolio of educational technology solutions, including ClassVR, FunFloor, Scottie Go!, Photon, ClassWise, CyberFox, WhalesBot Robotics, Korbo, and Future Classroom. These solutions cover a wide range of learning needs, from immersive virtual reality and interactive learning environments to robotics, programming, and AI-powered learning platforms. Through these technologies, Aktin Next aims to empower educators with the tools and resources they need to create more dynamic learning experiences while helping students develop essential skills such as computational thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and digital literacy. Visit the Aktin Next booth at BETT Asia to discover our latest education technology solutions in action, and explore partnership and reseller opportunities for your school, institution, or region. Meet our team to learn how Aktin Next can support your education technology needs and help bring innovative learning experiences to more students.

Applicaa is a UK-founded EdTech company that builds admissions and enrolment software for schools worldwide. Two teachers at a London secondary school, Guthrie Denniston and Tim Dixon, started the company in 2014 after struggling with paper-based admissions and manual data entry into their school's management information system. That experience led to Admissions+, first developed in 2016 and now used by over 2,500 schools, colleges and trusts. Admissions+ integrates directly with the MIS platforms many international schools already rely on, including iSAMS, SIMS, Bromcom and Arbor, so applicant data moves straight into student records without duplicate entry. Schools manage enquiries, applications, offers, enrolment and in-year transfers through customisable forms, automated parent communications and real-time dashboards. From summer 2026, an AI agent named Emma joins the platform, handling parent and staff queries, drafting follow-ups on stalled applications and creating events, communications and reports from plain-language instructions, so staff complete admin faster while staying in control, reviewing each action before it goes live.

company_name: ATHE Awards for Training and Higher Education
description: ATHE Academy is an innovative digital gateway designed to connect learners, recognised ATHE centres, and partner universities through a seamless global education journey. Built as an intuitive and interactive web app, the Academy helps students explore ATHE qualifications, discover approved centres, access progression opportunities with UK and international university partners, and engage with wider learning resources and CPD-certified courses. Supporting learner autonomy, it serves as a comprehensive knowledge hub that supports informed choices and lifelong learning. This new platform strengthens ATHE’s commitment to accessible, relevant, and internationally respected education. Regulated by Ofqual since 2011, ATHE works with more than 200 centres across 35 countries and has supported over 100,000 learners worldwide through qualifications spanning Levels 2 to 7 in areas such as business, accounting, law, digital technologies, and healthcare. By combining trusted qualifications, recognised progression pathways, and innovative learner support, ATHE Academy will create a connected global ecosystem that empowers students, educators, and international stakeholders to achieve academic progression, professional development, and greater global mobility.

BatOnRoute is a software for school transport that helps to manage and optimize the school bus routes. It does not require installation of any hardware on the buses. It provides the Parents with peace of mind while improving the management of school buses for schools by providing real-time information. BatOnRoute improves the communication with the Parents by sending automatic notifications (proximity of the bus, delays, the child’s embark and disembark) and allowing them to notify the school about the absences and change of routes using their parental app. The schools, on another hand, increase safety during their school runs, gain a better insight to what is happening during school transport by means of a wide variety of reports and reduce their administrative workload. BatOnRoute helps to manage the routes of over 900 schools in 30 countries. It is integrated with many schools' MIS, iSAMS and PowerSchool among others.

Blocksi takes pride in being a global software provider with over a decade of experience in the industry. Our solutions include internet filtering to safeguard students from harmful content around the clock, seamless classroom organization tools for educators, and student safety.

Bolt Inventors brings STEM and design thinking to life through hands-on learning for students in Grades 1–12. Our complete programs combine practical invention kits, engaging storytelling, coding, and real-world problem solving to help students develop creativity, confidence, and engineering skills. Designed for classroom teaching, after-school enrichment, and holiday camps, each program includes tools and materials, structured lesson plans, videos, workbooks, and teacher training. Educators also gain access to the Bolt Vault, our digital teaching resource library. From exploring circuits and simple machines to building and programming robots, Bolt Inventors makes it easier for schools to deliver inspiring STEM experiences without specialist laboratories or expensive equipment.

Booster was established in 2023 in Haidian District, Beijing. It is a national high‑tech enterprise and a Beijing‑certified "Specialized, Refined, Differentiated, and Innovative" enterprise. Booster Robotics is a technology company focused on the R&D of humanoid robot hardware, operating systems, and development tools. With the vision of "making humanoid robots as simple, reliable, and practical as computers," it builds full‑chain competitiveness from hardware to software to the embodied development ecosystem, and is committed to collaborating with global developers to drive productivity transformation.

LearnEnglishAbc.com is an online English-learning platform designed to help ESL students improve their skills at their own pace. The site combines structured lessons, English grammar, vocabulary, reading, pronunciation, books, music, and practical learning tools in one place. Learners can study 45 English lessons, explore more than 160 books, and use songs with lyrics to strengthen listening and comprehension. The platform also includes HOPE, an AI-powered English tutor that allows students to practice speaking, ask questions, improve pronunciation, and review saved conversations. LearnEnglishAbc supports learners from basic through more advanced levels and is designed for students, adult learners, teachers, schools, and organizations worldwide. Free resources remain available, while paid memberships provide broader lesson access and additional features. The goal of LearnEnglishAbc is simple: make English learning affordable, flexible, engaging, and accessible so students can learn with confidence whenever and wherever they choose.

Bricks Education is one of the prominent ELT publishing companies in Korea. We operate a research and development team that aims to provide diverse contents to meet the needs of our readers. The R&D team consists of English teaching experts who do their utmost to develop contents and education materials of the highest quality. In addition, our experienced marketing professionals at Bricks strive to meet the needs of our readers and supporters. Today, Bricks centers on expanding the business in the areas of online contents, development of textbooks, and English education programs. We are also developing and operating an integrated LMS platform that serves as a comprehensive solution covering both learning management and overall operational features for schools and academies.

Build Education - architects of AI-powered learning environments, built to fit your context. Co-designed with each partner and delivered in any language, we turn your content and expertise into personalised, adaptive tutors and trainers your organisation owns. We start with your world - your pedagogy, learners, curriculum and training materials - not generic, one-size-fits-all AI. Every partner works with a dedicated Learning Architect: a human counterpart who co-designs the environment and refines it using real learning data. Because measurement is built in, you see what's actually happening - engagement, progress, completion and where each learner needs support - with insights and safeguarding surfaced through a facilitator dashboard. Unlike passive e-learning, it proves real learning happens, not just content delivered. The same craft adapts across schools, ministries of education, vocational and workforce training, universities and business schools - always locally relevant and inclusive by design. It works online with an offline failsafe, and is already proven in live pilots across the UK, Africa and Asia.

We work with governments and organisations around the world to develop education systems that create lasting impact. As part of the University of Cambridge, we bring our research and global experience together with your local knowledge to improve outcomes for learners. We collaborate with partners on digital innovation and more across the education transformation journey. Our work spans curriculum, assessment, teacher development and learning resources. We partner with you to develop solutions that reflect your unique priorities, ensure different parts of the system support one another and drive sustainable change. Through evidence and practical expertise, we help leaders make informed decisions – and go on to deliver them. This includes using tools such as Discover, which helps you gather and understand data to inform your next steps. It also includes partnerships with UNICEF, GPE and HP on programmes that support leaders to develop the networks and skills to use technology to strengthen education. Across every partnership, our focus is the same: empowering educators and improving learning to equip every child for the future.

Canvas , developed by Instructure , is a leading learning management platform that helps institutions deliver engaging, high-quality digital learning experiences. The platform provides educators with an intuitive environment to design courses, manage assessments, and track learner progress across online, blended, and workplace-based delivery models. Reliable and scalable by design, Canvas integrates seamlessly with a broad ecosystem of education technologies. By simplifying teaching workflows and improving visibility across learning delivery, Canvas enables institutions to create flexible learning environments that support both educators and learners. As part of Instructure’s platform, Canvas helps organisations strengthen learning outcomes and adapt to the evolving needs of education.

The Council for Advancement and Support of Education (CASE) is the global nonprofit association dedicated to educational advancement—alumni relations, communications, development, marketing, and advancement services—and championing education to transform lives and society.

CENTURY is the award-winning, AI-powered teaching, learning, and assessment platform trusted by leading international schools and school groups in more than 70 countries worldwide. Fully aligned with the English National Curriculum, the IB framework (PYP and MYP), Cambridge, and major international exam boards, CENTURY delivers a truly personalised learning experience for every student and explains why CENTURY has a footprint in every major British global school chain. Using proprietary AI technology, CENTURY continuously analyses student performance to identify knowledge gaps and misconceptions. It recommends an adaptive pathway of engaging micro-lessons featuring videos, slideshows, and auto-marked questions, created by experienced educators. This personalised approach promotes metacognition, encourages independent learning, and drives measurable improvements in outcomes. Powerful yet intuitive dashboards provide actionable insights at student, class, school, and leadership levels, enabling educators to make informed decisions, deliver targeted interventions, and maximise impact. Now expanding beyond teaching and learning, CENTURY also offers a growing suite of assessment solutions, including academic baseline and endline assessments, wellbeing surveys, cognitive ability testing (launching 2027). By bringing together AI-powered learning, robust assessment, and evidence-based pedagogy in one integrated platform, CENTURY enables schools to triangulate data, close learning gaps, enhance teaching, reduce administration, and unlock every learner’s potential.

Chamomile AI is a software R&D studio with over a decade of experience developing complex cybersecurity product solutions. Since 2023, we have extended our engineering-first culture into AI solutions for education, helping Fortune 100 companies, edtech startups, and training organisations leverage AI safely and sustainably. Our edtech work is reflected in Tidalic, a Chamomile AI software solution that puts time management at the centre of learning. Higher education students and emerging talent face unprecedented challenges in today’s uncertain environment, creating an urgent need for effective support in self-regulated learning. Tidalic helps learners turn intention into action by streamlining planning, prioritisation, and follow-through, supporting more successful and independent learning outcomes, as well as improved student wellbeing and retention.

With a wealth of practical qualifications, events, and networking opportunities on offer, we help people boost their career prospects and connect them with other ambitious professionals across all industries and sectors. In fact, we have more than 100k people training to be better managers right now. Backed by a unique Royal Charter, we are the only organisation that can award Chartered Manager status – the ultimate management accolade. Our thought leadership, research and online resources provide practical insight for both today’s leaders and the next generation. This insight also means we can confidently represent our 230,000 plus membership community when speaking to policy makers. This is all in aid of one simple goal: to increase the number and standard of professionally qualified managers.

CIRCULUS is an AI and robotics education company dedicated to “AI Education for Everyone.” We specialize in Physical AI–based learning solutions that integrate robotics, generative AI, and on-device AI technologies to deliver practical, future-ready education. Our core offerings include a humanoid AI coding robot (pibo), an on-device AI kit (pibrain), and a generative AI platform (Canvers), enabling students to design, build, and interact with intelligent systems in real-world contexts. CIRCULUS develops project-based learning (PBL) programs that encourage students to define problems and create solutions through hands-on experiences. Our solutions are optimized for K–12 education, supporting both students and educators with standardized resources and training. By combining Physical AI, digital literacy, and real-world problem-solving, CIRCULUS is building a scalable and inclusive AI education ecosystem.

Class Of Your Own (COYO) is an award-winning social enterprise that helps schools prepare learners for the careers and challenges of the future through innovative, project-based education. Our internationally recognised Design Engineer Construct! (DEC) programme inspires young people to explore architecture, engineering, construction and the wider built environment while developing the knowledge, skills and mindsets needed in a rapidly changing world. Designed for learners aged 4–18, DEC aligns with the English National Curriculum, and the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP), making it an ideal addition to international school curricula. Through authentic design challenges based on real-world projects, students develop critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, digital literacy and sustainability awareness while applying STEM learning in meaningful contexts. Beyond curriculum resources, COYO provides comprehensive teacher professional development, implementation support and opportunities to connect schools with industry professionals and universities. Delivered in leading international schools across Europe, the Middle East and Asia, DEC enables schools to strengthen STEM provision, enhance careers education and develop globally minded, future-ready learners. By connecting education with industry, Class Of Your Own empowers students to become the architects, engineers, designers and innovators who will shape a more sustainable and resilient future.

ClassLink is the global leader in identity and access management for education. School systems around the world rely on ClassLink for access, automation, and analytics products that create more time for learning. Education leaders turn to ClassLink for evidence on screen time and how edtech usage connects with student outcomes. ClassLink empowers 25 million students and staff in over 3,000 school systems. Visit classlink.com to learn more.

Data Harvest has supported science education for more than 40 years, since pioneering science-based data capture technology in the UK in 1983. Its combination of hardware and software helps schools deliver engaging, hands-on science learning while supporting the shift to digital education. The company’s wireless sensor technology enables students to visualise scientific concepts that are often invisible, turning abstract ideas into meaningful learning experiences. By collecting and analysing real-time data, students develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and investigative skills while learning to formulate questions, test hypotheses, and draw evidence-based conclusions. Data Harvest’s EasySense2 software and wireless sensing solutions use Bluetooth technology and work across iOS, Android, Windows, Chromebook, and macOS devices. Suitable for individual, teacher-led, and collaborative learning, the platform supports science education throughout a student’s academic journey, helping inspire future scientists, engineers, and innovators

description: Edmentum partners with schools to accelerate learner growth and expand opportunity through trusted K–Career curriculum, assessment, and instruction solutions. With more than 60 years of innovation in education, we put educators first, helping them understand learner needs, individualize learning, and strengthen student outcomes wherever learning occurs. From building strong foundations and supporting multilingual learners to expanding course access, diploma pathways, university readiness, and career exploration, our flexible solutions support progress across the learner journey. By combining research-informed technology, actionable insight, practical support, and long-term partnership, Edmentum helps schools deliver consistent, scalable and inclusive learning experiences across classrooms and campuses. Working with educators worldwide, we are committed to moving education forward and preparing every learner with the confidence, knowledge, and opportunities they need for what comes next.

Efekta Education Group is an innovative EdTech company focused on improving educational outcomes at scale - helping students learn faster and go further by making personal tutoring affordable and accessible in public and private school systems. Efekta is an EF (Education First) company. EF is one of the leading global education providers and has been pioneering experiential language learning through international language travel since 1965. Efekta has taken that experience, reach, and data to provide the world’s largest online platform for teaching English in school systems at scale. We supercharge both teachers and students with our AI-powered curriculum, AI personal tutor for Students, and Classroom AI tools for Teachers. Our technology is based on data and experience from the world’s largest online English school and 60 years of leadership in the field of immersive education. Our immersive AI adapts in real-time to each learner’s needs. To date, Efekta’s technology has taught over 24 million people and is currently used by more than four million active students, 25,000 teachers, 3,000 corporate clients, and several governments worldwide. Efekta is addressing global challenges of accessibility, quality, and teacher shortages, with plans to add 100 million students in the next 3-5 years.

ETute is an all-in-one school management solution for K-12 schools with built in AI assistance for admissions, academics and timetabling, examinations, fee collection, library, transport, payroll, visitors and parent communication in one mobile-first system, built for multi-branch groups. What sets ETute apart is "NILI", its built-in AI assistant. Instead of hunting through reports, staff simply ask: "Which teachers haven't submitted lesson plans?" · "What's our fee collection percentage?" A parent asks, "How is my child doing?" NILI answers from the school's live records in seconds. NILI is built to be trusted, not just clever. Every answer comes from your real data it never guesses and says so when it doesn't know. Each user sees only what their role permits, enforced at the database. And NILI never changes anything on its own: it drafts the action, a human confirms.

Excellence Online Academy is a UK-based education and skills development provider that develops and delivers high-quality online programmes designed to prepare young people and professionals for success in a rapidly changing world. Our programmes in English language learning, entrepreneurship, leadership, innovation, financial literacy, and professional development equip learners with the future-ready knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to thrive in education, employment, and entrepreneurship. We offer flexible learning solutions that can be delivered live by our expert educators or licensed to schools and educational organisations, enabling them to integrate engaging, curriculum-aligned programmes into their existing provision. Designed to be practical, interactive, and easy to implement, our programmes foster communication, creativity, critical thinking, collaboration, leadership, and entrepreneurial mindsets. As a Cambridge English Qualifications Preparation Centre and Cambridge Placement Test Centre, we are committed to maintaining high educational standards while expanding access to quality learning globally. Excellence Online Academy collaborates with international organisations, educators, and industry experts to deliver innovative learning experiences and build meaningful partnerships that expand access to high-quality education and empower learners to succeed in an increasingly interconnected world.

We empower schools and learners worldwide with integrated, intelligent, human-centered technology, and learning solutions that transform education, making it better in every sense. We deliver a comprehensive ecosystem of seamlessly connected tools that streamline school operations, enhance teaching and learning, and enable data-informed decision-making at every level. Whether it's unlocking insights through AI-powered analytics, fostering communication across school communities, or personalizing learning at scale, we are the trusted partner for forward-thinking schools. Guided by decades of experience and a relentless pursuit of better, we shape our solutions to local needs while scaling globally, ensuring that every school, educator, learner, and family thrives.

Future Classroom was built on a simple observation: schools are being asked to teach AI, but most have no way to prepare their teachers for it. Rather than build another coding curriculum, Future Classroom set out to solve the harder problem, giving educators, technical or not, the confidence and pedagogy to teach AI and emerging technology well. The result is a browser-based platform covering the full learning journey: training, delivery, and assessment for AI, coding, and emerging technologies, requiring no installation or specialist IT setup . Its structured program spans 10 modules and 500+ hours of learning, taking students from first exposure to applied, real-world skills, with teacher readiness built into every step rather than treated as an afterthought. Future Classroom is already trusted by thousands of students, helping schools meet the growing demand for AI literacy, while still building strong foundational coding skills, without needing to hire specialist staff. Visit our booth at BETT Asia to see Future Classroom in action, and to discuss partnership and reseller opportunities for your school or region.

Google for Education’s commitment is helping to expand learning for everyone. We believe that everyone—educators and learners at every age and stage—deserve the tools and skills that set them up for success in building the future they want for themselves. Google tools and resources help school teachers and students create, collaborate, and build digital skills for the future. Our shareable devices and collaborative tools help teachers prepare all students with new, more engaging ways to learn the skills they need to succeed.

GOTT Sdn. Bhd. is one of the leading suppliers of TVET (Technical and Vocational Education and Training) equipment and STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics) solutions. With over 18 years of industry experience, GOTT specializes in delivering advanced educational tools and infrastructure to vocational training institutions, educational organizations and industry partners. Our product portfolio includes technical skill development tools, training simulators, STEAM products and multimedia-enabled educational devices, designed to support effective, hands-on learning and skills development. GOTT is committed to providing reliable, innovative and industry-relevant training solutions, supported by ISO 9001:2015 certification and Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC) accreditation. Our products and solutions have been exported to over 44 countries, reflecting our growing international presence and commitment to quality in education and training.

Hachette Learning (formerly Hodder Education) is an education publisher with more than 150 years of publishing expertise, dedicated to unlocking every learner’s unique potential. They provide digital learning platforms and tools, high-quality print curriculum resources, targeted intervention and professional development that support better outcomes for schools, learners, multi-academy trusts (MATs), school groups, families and those shaping education systems worldwide. Today, their tools and resources are used in more than 140 countries, supporting learning from age three through to 19+. Their role is to make improvement clearer, more joined-up and easier to sustain, in real classrooms - not just on paper. Through trusted resources and expert insight, they help educators to teach, assess, and enable learning with confidence. Part of Hachette UK, which was founded in 1846, Hachette Learning operates through offices and teams around the world.

HAKUBUN, founded in 1957, is Japan’s leading developer of science education materials for elementary schools. Our products are widely used in classrooms across the country, earning the trust of teachers and establishing our position as the largest provider in Japan’s science education market. As specialists in science education, we create materials that not only deepen children's understanding and spark their curiosity, but also support teachers in delivering effective and engaging lessons. We are committed to nurturing future generations who will excel in scientific fields and contribute to society through new technologies and innovation. By improving both the learning experience for children and the teaching process for educators, we aim to strengthen the foundation of future talent development. Guided by our core philosophy—bringing sincerity and creativity to education that supports future generations—we continue to develop products aligned with emerging educational concepts and the evolving needs of schools.

IBM is investing in the future of work with free, stackable learning and credentials through IBM SkillsBuild, delivered with governments, universities and nonprofits worldwide. IBM SkillsBuild is a free education program aimed at increasing access to technology education. We’re committed to skill 30 million people by 2030 and to train 2 million learners in AI by 2026 and have reached 16M+ learners across 160 countries to date. IBM’s commitment to education and skills goes back nearly a century (e.g., 1940s curriculum work with Columbia University).

At Intel we create world-changing technology that enriches the lives of every person on earth. We are inspired to: Drive innovation that makes the world safer, builds healthy and vibrant communities, and increases productivity. Harness our reach around the globe to better society, business, and the planet. Push ourselves and our industry peers to be more responsible, inclusive, and sustainable. We have big ambitions, and a growing sense of urgency to work with others and address world challenges no one can tackle alone.

Jupiter is a learning management system for K-12 schools, scalable from the smallest charter schools to districts with 100,000’s of students. Jupiter features include a robust gradebook coupled with a seamless learning management system and optional student management system.

Our focus is simple: we create schools where students and educators do their best work. As a British-owned design studio, our integrated team of 470+ multidisciplinary specialists spans over 20 countries. Designing exclusively for education, we bring strategy, architecture, interior design, engineering, and manufacturing under one roof. This allows ideas to move seamlessly from concept to delivery without losing intent. Grounded in research, collaboration, and real school behaviour, we use evidence-based insights to craft environments that boost student confidence and well-being. Our framework, Beyond the Box , leverages neuro-architecture and pedagogy to tackle how physical space shapes learning. Our integrated approach has successfully delivered over 850 schools, 1,000+ distinct learning spaces, and 1 million items of specialized furniture worldwide. We believe in working closely with the schools and operators we partner with makes our work grounded in research and real operational behaviour, ensuring environments perform in daily use and support long-term educational value.

company_name: Knowledge Transfer Sub-office, The Education University of Hong Kong
description: The Entrepreneurship Development Unit (EDuce), part of the Knowledge Transfer Sub-office at The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK), is dedicated to fostering a vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem for the EdUHK community. By supporting innovators and entrepreneurs, EDuce helps transform breakthrough research and creative start-up ideas into sustainable, impactful enterprises. Strategic partnerships with key stakeholders further enhance our mission to make a positive difference in society. To provide all-rounded support, EDuce hosts entrepreneurship and research centres at two world-class incubators in Hong Kong. Our initiatives include the EASE Fund, which offers seed funding, and the INVESTED Program, which nurtures student talent. We empower EdUHK entrepreneurs with training, consultation, mentorship services, access to investor networks, and fast-track pathways to renowned incubators. Together, we drive innovation and social impact, supporting the growth and success of EdUHK’s entrepreneurial community.

Learning Resource Network (LRN) is a UK-regulated awarding organisation delivering internationally recognised qualifications to schools and education providers in more than 58 countries. Honoured with the Queen's Award for Enterprise (2020) and the King's Award for Enterprise for International Trade (2026), LRN is committed to innovation, quality and preparing learners for the future. At BETT Asia 2026, LRN is showcasing its comprehensive Artificial Intelligence (AI) education pathway. Starting from Early Years and Primary Education, learners develop digital literacy, computational thinking and responsible AI awareness. This progresses to International GCSE and International A Level Artificial Intelligence, where students study machine learning, data science, intelligent systems, AI ethics, programming and real-world applications. Developed with educators, academics and industry experts, LRN's AI qualifications equip learners with the knowledge and practical skills needed for higher education and careers in artificial intelligence, computer science and emerging technologies. By embedding AI across every stage of education, LRN is helping schools prepare the next generation of innovators and responsible digital leaders.

Lightspeed Systems® patented technology was imagined and designed just for education: Lightspeed Alert™ gives schools immediate insights in to signs of self-harm, cyberbullying and violence. Lightspeed Filter™ provides scalable, safeguarding and reporting. Lightspeed Classroom™ gives teachers an overview of all online classroom activity and gives internet controls. Lightspeed Insight™ gives schools real-time insights into app and device usage and to saving money and ensuring compliance. Lightspeed MDM™ gives hierarchical, centralised control of devices features and apps. Lightspeed Signal™ lets schools Identify device, network, and app issues. Lightspeed StopIt™ allows fully anonymous app, web, or phone reporting for safeguarding concerns.

Linewize by Qoria is the world's leading provider of filtering and digital safety solutions, working across both sides of a child's digital life. A student's online world moves constantly, between lessons and home, learning and distraction, everyday activity and moments of risk. Linewize helps schools see and respond across that whole journey. Filtering sets the right boundaries. Teachers can see and steer internet use in lessons as it happens. AI surfaces wellbeing signals, with trained moderators cutting false positives so schools can focus on what matters. Beyond the school gate, parents have controls of their own to help guide behaviour at home. Today, Linewize supports 32,000 schools and 9 million parents across 100 countries, helping 30 million children navigate their digital lives more safely at school and at home - by putting the right tools in the right hands, at the right time.

company_name: LLONGWILL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY SDN. BHD
description: LLONGWILL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY SDN. BHD. was established in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in 2024. The main business involves the research, development, production, and sales of digital teaching instruments, as well as a full range of education-related products. LLONGWILL provides comprehensive digital solutions for experimental teaching in high schools, middle schools, and primary schools, encompassing sensors, data loggers, experimental teaching software, and supporting experimental equipment for physics, chemistry, biology, geography, and other subjects. This supports comprehensive science experimental teaching at the basic education stage and serves as a powerful guarantee for inquiry-based teaching and STEM education.

BTG Global Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian EdTech company building the next generation of intelligent education infrastructure. Founded with the belief that every child deserves equal access to quality attention — regardless of where they study or who teaches them — BTG Global developed MarianaMatric, an AI-powered teaching and academic administration platform designed for the complexity of real schools. MarianaMatric connects four stakeholders — school management, teachers, students, and parents — in a single unified system that mirrors how schools actually work. At its core is a proprietary AI engine that continuously learns from every classroom interaction — turning raw assessment data into smarter teaching, automatically. BTG Global's mission is not incremental improvement. It is a structural rethink of how teaching works at scale — so that no student falls through the cracks, and no teacher carries a burden that AI can shoulder instead.

Mathspace is on a mission to help every student excel at mathematics, no matter where they're starting from. Founded in Sydney in 2010, the company set out to solve a problem most maths software ignored as kids don't just need the right answer, they need help understanding how to get there. Mathspace is now an Australian-founded, award-winning adaptive maths platform used by millions of students worldwide, including more than one in three Australian schools. Its signature StepSmart technology tracks a student's working line by line, catching misconceptions the moment they happen rather than waiting until the final answer is marked wrong. Mathspace was also the first edtech company in Australia, and one of the first in the world, to build GPT-4 into its chatbot, Milo, giving students a safe, always-on companion for maths help. Today, Mathspace partners with schools across Australia, the Middle East, Europe, and Asia-Pacific to make personalised, one-to-one style maths support accessible in every classroom.

MathsWatch is a multi-award-winning solution that supports teachers' delivery of the Maths curriculum while reducing their workload. We provide teachers and their students with high-quality videos covering every Maths topic, combined with banks of interactive questions that can be used for classwork/homework/assessment/independent learning. Our innovative marking algorithms have revolutionised the way teachers can deliver quality Maths lessons to their students, as we are the only platform worldwide able to give marks for working out and not merely for final answers. This revolutionary feature makes the MathsWatch experience much more realistic and beneficial to students than most traditional quiz-setting platforms. Furthermore, our popular modelled exams offer the best possible preparation to students before their final GCSE/IGCSE/SATs exams. They can see their grade progression as they advance and clearly identify their strengths and areas of development. A truly immersive experience. All this is offered to schools by MathsWatch at one of the most competitive price points currently on the market.

Meritto is an AI-powered enrollment platform built for the global education industry. Trusted by 1000+ institutions worldwide, Meritto offers an integrated suite of purpose-built tools including an Education CRM, Enrollment Cloud, Application Platform, Payment Cloud, and Engagement Suite that streamline every step of the student journey, from inquiry to enrollment. Designed for scalability, security, and easy integration, Meritto supports educational organizations of all sizes from EdTechs and training providers to universities, schools, and study abroad firms. With intelligent automation, real-time data, and powerful engagement capabilities, Meritto is redefining how education teams attract, convert, and enroll students across the globe.

The Ministry of Education, Malaysia (MOE) is the federal ministry responsible for shaping and delivering Malaysia’s education system. Guided by its vision of “Quality Education, Educated People, Prosperous Nation,” the Ministry is committed to sustaining a quality education system that develops individual potential and fulfils the aspirations of the nation. MOE oversees education across a broad spectrum, including preschool, primary, secondary and post-secondary education, technical and vocational education and training (TVET), special education, teacher education and private educational institutions. The Ministry also leads the development and implementation of national education policies, planning and programmes to strengthen the quality, accessibility and effectiveness of education. Through its network of schools, educational institutions and education offices nationwide, MOE works with stakeholders to nurture knowledgeable, skilled and well-rounded individuals. The Ministry also embraces educational resources and technology to enhance teaching and learning and prepare learners for the challenges of the future.

Moddakir is a Saudi company specializing in the EdTech sector, focusing on remote education and innovative digital learning solutions. Through its platform, Moddakir connects learners with qualified instructors for live, one-on-one sessions available 24/7. The company also provides various technical solutions—including White Label models, SDK integration, and SaaS solutions—as well as AI services, enabling educational institutions and stakeholders to efficiently launch and manage customized digital learning platforms. Moddakir has served over 1.7 million beneficiaries across more than 150 countries.

Open LMS is a highly configurable learning management system (LMS) that scales to the goals of your organization. We help thousands of customers globally, from industry to higher education, by providing a familiar experience for learners, cutting-edge ecosystem tools, in-depth reporting and data, in-app authoring, learning pathways, and compliance training and reporting. As the world’s largest commercial provider of hosting and support services for open-source Moodle™, supported by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Open LMS helps organizations deliver great learning experiences without complexities. Open LMS is part of Learning Technologies Group’s award-winning group of specialist learning technology and talent management businesses. Learn more about Open LMS at www.openlms.net

Health education that starts before the problem. Peach Wellness Academy is a digital health and wellbeing platform helping education settings build health literacy before health problems arise. Created by UK-based doctors and psychologists, PWA brings together healthcare professionals, teachers and people with lived experience to deliver engaging, evidence-informed learning. Predominantly video-based, programmes combine expert insight with interactive quizzes and activities designed for today’s learners. We address a growing challenge: young people are navigating health information, online misinformation and pressures on their physical and mental wellbeing, while educators are expected to deliver health education without specialist expertise, time or resources. Our flexible programmes support secondary schools, further and higher education, international schools and staff wellbeing. Content can be tailored to your setting, curriculum, learners and priorities. We believe health literacy is fundamental to healthy, confident learners and lifelong decision-making. PWA helps educators give young people the knowledge, skills and confidence to understand themselves, cut through the noise and make informed choices.

Pestalozzi Technology is an EdTech company transforming physical education through digital innovation. Our flagship platform, ALPHA, helps schools digitize physical fitness assessments, providing instant analysis, personalized feedback for every student, and actionable insights for teachers and school leaders. Used by more than 5,200 schools and supporting over 2 million students across Japan, ALPHA enables educators to move beyond simply measuring fitness to fostering lifelong health literacy and active learning. By visualizing fitness trends and recommending individualized improvement strategies, the platform empowers students to understand their own physical development and take ownership of their health. As we expand globally, Pestalozzi Technology partners with schools, education authorities, and organizations to create healthier, more active generations through data-driven, human-centered physical education.

Promethean, a global pioneer in interactive learning technology since 1997, is trusted by educators worldwide for its award-winning technology and software ecosystem. STboard combines its own manufacturing and hardware expertise with authorized Promethean branding and software, delivering powerful integrated smart classroom solutions across Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines and South Korea. STboard Manufacturing × Promethean Brand & Software One Solution. Global Technology. Local Service.

Renaissance is a global leader in K–12 education, serving more than 20 million students across 100+ countries. Together with GL Education, we provide evidence-based assessment, practice, intervention and data analytics solutions that help schools accelerate learning and improve outcomes. Backed by nearly 40 years of research and over 2.8 billion student learning data points, our solutions enable educators to identify strengths, address learning gaps and support every learner’s progress. Our portfolio includes Accelerated Reader for independent reading practice; CAT4 for measuring developed abilities and potential; Freckle for personalised maths practice; Lalilo for early literacy development; myON for personalised digital reading; and Nearpod for interactive teaching and formative assessment. We also offer trusted assessment tools including the New Group Reading Test (NGRT), Pupil Attitudes to Self and School (PASS), and the Progress Test Series (PT Series) to help schools monitor attainment, wellbeing and progress. Star Assessments provide actionable insights into reading, mathematics and early literacy, while Renaissance Analytics brings school data together in one powerful platform, helping educators make informed decisions and demonstrate impact with confidence. Together, these solutions support schools in driving student growth and helping all learners reach their full potential.

Robocore Technology is a robotics and intelligent automation company bringing practical AI into real-world environments through its flagship platform, temi. At Bett Asia, Robocore showcases how autonomous service robots can support the evolving needs of education ecosystems—enhancing campus experience, improving operational efficiency, and enabling more connected, tech-enabled learning spaces. temi functions as an intelligent on-site assistant, capable of guiding students and visitors, delivering real-time information, supporting hybrid learning interactions, and streamlining administrative touchpoints. Already deployed across public spaces, healthcare, and commercial environments, temi is now increasingly relevant in education settings—from K-12 campuses to higher education institutions and training centers. Through a flexible Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, Robocore enables institutions to adopt robotics with minimal friction, helping address staffing constraints while elevating student engagement and digital transformation outcomes.

Founded in 2001, Robotron Co., Ltd. is a Korean STEAM robotics education company specializing in the development and manufacturing of educational robot kits, block-based coding robots, and integrated science curricula. Robotron designs both its hardware and learning content in-house, offering a complete range of products — from early-childhood block robots to advanced step-by-step coding platforms that build logical thinking and creativity. With over two decades of supplying schools across Korea's public education system, and holding domestic and international safety certifications, Robotron pairs proven manufacturing quality with curriculum-driven learning. At Bett Asia 2026, Robotron is seeking international distributors and education partners to bring its trusted, made-in-Korea robotics education to new markets worldwide.

The Invigilator is an innovative education technology company specializing in online proctoring and digital assessment solutions. Founded to help institutions maintain academic integrity in remote and blended learning environments, the company provides technology that enables secure, scalable, and user-friendly online examinations. Its platform incorporates identity verification, examination monitoring, behavioural analysis, and advanced security features designed to support trustworthy assessment outcomes. The Invigilator places strong emphasis on privacy, compliance, and ethical AI, embedding privacy-by-design and security-by-design principles into its products and development processes. Serving higher education institutions, professional bodies, and training organisations, the company continually enhances its solutions through technological innovation, AI-driven capabilities, and seamless integrations with learning and assessment ecosystems. With a growing international presence and a commitment to improving assessment integrity, The Invigilator helps institutions confidently deliver credible digital assessments while adapting to the evolving future of education and skills certification.

Wayground is an AI-supported, teacher-first supplemental learning platform that brings instruction, practice, and assessment together in one hub. Formerly known as Quizizz, Wayground helps educators create engaging learning experiences, find ready-to-use resources, and understand student progress without adding more complexity to the school day. From formative checks and interactive lessons to differentiated practice, Wayground supports the many ways students learn. AI works in the background through tools such as AI Create, AI Enhance, and AI Analyze, helping teachers spend less time preparing and more time responding to what their students need. Teachers remain in control, because technology should strengthen human connection, not replace it. Trusted by teachers in over 90% of U.S. schools and used in 150 countries, Wayground helps schools make learning more accessible, engaging, and meaningful. Whether educators are introducing a new concept, reinforcing key skills, or checking for understanding, Wayground helps every student find their way.

White Rose Education is a well-known UK-based organisation focussed on providing high-quality mathematics and science education resources for teachers and students. We provide a structured set of teaching materials, lesson guidance, worksheets, and videos that are designed to help educators implement effective teaching in the classroom. The resources cover a wide range of topics across both primary and secondary phases. We also offer support for professional development for teachers, workshops, and training materials to help educators effectively teach mathematics and science using evidence-based approaches. Our resources are written by teachers, for teachers and our vision is to provide a world-class education, for everyone, everywhere.

ZEP is a leading Korean metaverse-based EdTech and corporate training platform with over 17 million users.
